summary: Today presents a mixed briefing driven by major retail market transactions, including Reliance's ₹1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh and Bodhi Tree's $180 million A2B buyout. These strategic commercial expansions are accompanied by legal policy developments from the Kerala High Court and executive legal training initiatives.

bullets.text: Reliance announced a ₹1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh to establish biogas plants, aiming to create 3 lakh job opportunities.
Bodhi Tree Systems is investing $180 million for a majority stake in restaurant chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan to fund expansion.
SoftBank offloaded 7.64 crore shares in Bengaluru-based Meesho worth ₹1,885 crore through block deals on the NSE.
The Kerala High Court recommended reducing the juvenile age limit to 16 years.
IIM Ahmedabad and Tata Group trained over 100 in-house lawyers in business strategy and corporate leadership.
